The Nursing RN to BSN is a Bachelor of Science in Nursing track for registered nurses prepared at the Associate’s degree or Diploma level. Students transfer credits from their initial nursing program and complete general education and nursing requirements at Ramapo. That's stressful, but one bad grade doesn't decide everything. Talking with your professor and an advisor soon can really help.

The Office of the Provost’s catalog describes grade appeals. An appeal requires supporting documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. Appeals based only on wanting a higher grade, or a grade penalty for an Academic Integrity violation, are not considered. A degree’s record cannot be adjusted after the degree is conferred. [1][2]

If you are an undergraduate: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to the course instructor with supporting documentation. Both sides should make good-faith efforts to discuss the issue; you and the instructor have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you agree on an adjustment, the instructor sends the Instructor Grade Adjustment Request and supporting documents to the sponsoring academic unit’s Dean for approval, then to the Registrar. [3] If you cannot agree, submit a written appeal by email or certified letter, with relevant course materials or coursework, to that Dean within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Dean has 15 calendar days to decide. If the Dean rejects your appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination, with a written statement and evidence contradicting the decision or information previously unavailable. [3]

If you are a graduate student: the initial written appeal and 20-calendar-day deadline are the same, but address the faculty member. If unresolved, appeal in writing to the graduate program Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Director recommends a decision to the Dean for final approval. The provided procedure describes a further petition to the supervising Dean if the Director does not support your appeal; it gives no deadline for that petition. [4]

You may have an emotional support animal on campus if you have a disability, register with OSS, provide documentation demonstrating the animal’s benefits, and are granted an accommodation permitting its presence. The Public Policy MPP is the Master of Public Policy in the School of Social Sciences and Social Work. It studies how government laws and policies shape lives, and prepares students in research methods and public policy analysis for work with or for public institutions. [1] Catalog: [https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-MPP-PBPL](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-MPP-PBPL) [1]

Requirements: Take all seven: PUBL 600 THE POLITICS OF POLICYMAKING; PUBL 601 FEDERAL PUBLIC POLICY & GOVERNANCE; PUBL 602 STATE & LOCAL PUBLIC POLICY; PUBL 616 ECONOMETRICS AND ANALYSIS; PUBL 618 PUBLIC MANAGEMENT; PUBL 621 POLITICAL ECONOMY; PUBL 705 PUBLIC POLICY INTERNSHIP. Select 3 at least 3 electives: ACCT 502 GOVERNMENT AND NOT-FOR-PROFIT ACCOUNTING; ACCT 625 INTERNATIONAL ACCOUNTING; BADM 501 DATA ANALYTICS; BADM 503 BUSINESS LAW, ETHICS & REGULATORY PRONOUNCEMENTS; DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE; DATA 670 DATA VISUALIZATION; MATH 570 APPLIED STATISTICS; MATH 685 INTRODUCTION TO EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN; MBAD 610 BECOMING A 21ST CENTURY LEADER; MBAD 625 CRISIS & CHANGE MANAGEMENT; NURS 660 LEADERSHIP AND INNOVATION IN HEALTHCARE; NURS 670 HEALTHCARE ECONOMICS AND FINANCE; NURS 808 HEALTH POLICY LEADERSHIP; MSWK 505 SOCIAL WELFARE PROGRAMS AND POLICIES I; MSWK 507 CULTURAL DIVERSITY, RACISM, OPPRESSION AND PRIVILEGE; MSWK 604 ADVANCED SOCIAL POLICY; MSWK 610 PUBLIC HEALTH IN WEST AFRICA; MSWK 670 SOCIAL WELFARE POLICIES IN HEALTH AND MENTAL HEALTH. [1]

Also published: Public Policy 4+1 and Public Policy Minor. [1]

Admissions page: [https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/requirements/](https://www.ramapo.edu/graduate/requirements/). The page lists one professional or academic letter of recommendation, submitted through the online application’s “Recommendations” section (Ramapo sends the automated request; references upload to the application portal). The letter is waived for current Ramapo students graduating in 2027 and recent Ramapo graduates from 2025 and 2026. It also lists a 400-word personal statement describing your interest, fit with personal intellectual development, and expected accomplishments, plus a resume. [6]

That's stressful, but one bad grade doesn't decide everything. Talking with your professor and an advisor soon can really help.

The Office of the Provost’s catalog says grade appeals require supporting documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. Appeals based only on wanting a higher grade, or on a grade penalty for an Academic Integrity violation, will not be considered. A degree’s record cannot be adjusted after the degree is conferred. [2]

Undergraduate: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to the course instructor with your appeal and supporting documentation. You and the instructor have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you cannot agree, send a written appeal with pertinent course materials or coursework to the Dean of the academic unit that sponsored the course within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. If the Dean’s opinion does not support your appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost in writing by email or certified letter within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination. Include your position and evidence contradicting the Dean’s decision or previously unavailable information. The petition must show clear evidence of a factual mistake, policy violation, or action outside the Dean’s purview; the Provost may reject it. [3]

Graduate: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to the faculty member with your appeal and supporting documentation. You and the faculty member have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you cannot agree, send a written appeal with pertinent course materials or coursework to the sponsoring graduate program’s Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Director’s decision is a recommendation to the Dean for final approval. If the Director’s opinion does not support your appeal, you may petition the Dean who supervises the program with a written statement and evidence contradicting the Director’s decision or previously unavailable information. [4]

The Office of Specialized Services (OSS) handles the accommodation request; Housing & Residence Life makes housing arrangements. [1][3][6]

1. Register for affiliation with OSS and initiate contact. See [“How To Request OSS Services”](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/). Submit comprehensive disability documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist so OSS can establish eligibility and determine appropriate accommodations. [3]
2. Complete the appropriate housing request forms. See the [OSS Housing Accommodations page](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/) for the forms and the [Housing Accommodation Request Policy](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2024/03/1-Housing-Accommodation-Request-Policy-updated-3-7-24.pdf). [5][7] If you request only a strobe alarm, roll-in shower, wheelchair/mobility accessible residence hall, or 1st floor, you do not need the Housing Accommodation Student or Provider Request Forms; complete a request for disability support form instead. [3]
3. Requests are reviewed by OSS and, in most cases, the Housing Accommodation Request Committee. You can expect a decision within twenty one (21) business days after OSS receives all requested documentation. If more information is needed, OSS will inform you in writing. [4][6]
4. Submit your request by Residence Life’s published deadlines. Accommodations depend on availability and are not guaranteed; a late OSS request may mean Residence Life cannot meet an approved accommodation for the semester requested. [1][2][7]

The College may permit an emotional support animal as a disability accommodation, but you must be registered with OSS, provide disability documentation showing the animal’s benefits, and receive an accommodation permitting it. Its presence may be limited to defined campus areas; it generally is not permitted in academic or recreational facilities. Approval is not guaranteed: housing accommodations are limited and first-come, first-served, and arrangements depend on availability. [2][3][7][15]

Office of Specialized Services (OSS):
1. Call the office at (201) 684-7514 to discuss your interest; interested students will be scheduled to meet with the OSS Director. [1]
2. Register/affiliate with OSS first. Initiate contact and submit comprehensive disability documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist. See “How To Request OSS Services”: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/) [5]
3. Submit the Animal Documentation Form: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2022/07/Animal-Documentation-Form-fillable-updated-7-5-22.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2022/07/Animal-Documentation-Form-fillable-updated-7-5-22.pdf) [6]
4. OSS and/or the Housing Accommodation Request Committee determine whether the request is reasonable. They may deny it if unreasonable or insufficiently documented; reasons include inadequate evidence, undue burden, a fundamental change to housing policy, or a direct threat/substantial property damage. For an ESA, the College may also ask its age and size/breed, if applicable. [4]

Submit housing requests by Residence Life’s published deadlines; OSS informs Residence Life of residents requiring accommodations based on documentation. A late request may prevent Residence Life from meeting an approved accommodation for the requested semester. [7][14][15]

The Public Policy MPP is a Master of Public Policy in the School of Social Sciences and Social Work. It focuses on how government laws and policies shape lives, and prepares students in research methods and policy analysis for work with or for public institutions. [1]

Requirements: Complete all 7 required courses: PUBL 600 THE POLITICS OF POLICYMAKING; PUBL 601 FEDERAL PUBLIC POLICY & GOVERNANCE; PUBL 602 STATE & LOCAL PUBLIC POLICY; PUBL 616 ECONOMETRICS AND ANALYSIS; PUBL 618 PUBLIC MANAGEMENT; PUBL 621 POLITICAL ECONOMY; PUBL 705 PUBLIC POLICY INTERNSHIP. Select 3 electives (at least 3) from: ACCT 502 GOVERNMENT AND NOT-FOR-PROFIT ACCOUNTING; ACCT 625 INTERNATIONAL ACCOUNTING; BADM 501 DATA ANALYTICS; BADM 503 BUSINESS LAW, ETHICS & REGULATORY PRONOUNCEMENTS; DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE; DATA 670 DATA VISUALIZATION; MATH 570 APPLIED STATISTICS; MATH 685 INTRODUCTION TO EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN; MBAD 610 BECOMING A 21ST CENTURY LEADER; MBAD 625 CRISIS & CHANGE MANAGEMENT; NURS 660 LEADERSHIP AND INNOVATION IN HEALTHCARE; NURS 670 HEALTHCARE ECONOMICS AND FINANCE; NURS 808 HEALTH POLICY LEADERSHIP; MSWK 505 SOCIAL WELFARE PROGRAMS AND POLICIES I; MSWK 507 CULTURAL DIVERSITY, RACISM, OPPRESSION AND PRIVILEGE; MSWK 604 ADVANCED SOCIAL POLICY; MSWK 610 PUBLIC HEALTH IN WEST AFRICA; MSWK 670 SOCIAL WELFARE POLICIES IN HEALTH AND MENTAL HEALTH. [1]

Also published: Public Policy 4+1 and Public Policy Minor. [1]

Graduate Admissions lists these MPP application materials: one professional or academic recommendation (waived for current Ramapo students graduating in 2027 and recent Ramapo graduates from 2025 and 2026); a 400-word personal statement on your interest, intellectual development, and what you expect to accomplish; and a resume. Enter references’ names and contact information in the online application’s ‘Recommendations’ section; Ramapo sends them an automated request and they upload recommendations to the application portal. [6]

That's stressful, but one bad grade doesn't decide everything. Talking with your professor and an advisor soon can really help.

Grade appeals are considered only in limited circumstances and require supporting documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. Appeals based only on wanting a higher grade, or on a grade imposed for an Academic Integrity violation, will not be considered. A degree’s academic record is closed after the degree is conferred. [2]

For an undergraduate course: write to the course instructor by email or certified letter, include supporting documentation, and do so within 20 calendar days after grades are posted. You and the instructor have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you cannot agree, submit a written appeal with pertinent course materials or coursework to the Dean of the academic unit that sponsored the course within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Dean has 15 calendar days to decide. If the Dean’s opinion does not support your appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost in writing by email or certified letter within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination; include your position and evidence that contradicts the Dean’s decision or was previously unavailable. The Provost may reject a petition without clear evidence of factual mistake, policy violation, or action outside the Dean’s purview. [3]

For a graduate course, start with the faculty member in writing by email or certified letter within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, with supporting documentation. You and the faculty member have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you cannot agree, appeal in writing, including pertinent course materials or coursework, to the sponsoring graduate program’s Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Director’s decision is a recommendation to the Dean for final approval. If the Director’s opinion does not support your appeal, you may petition the Dean who supervises the program; the page gives no deadline for this petition. [4]

You can ask for support with that.

Start with the Office of Specialized Services (OSS): you must affiliate/register with OSS before requesting a disability-related housing accommodation. Initiate contact with OSS; see “How To Request OSS Services” for details: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/) [3]

Request an Affiliation Packet through the OSS Quick Response Form ([https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/oss-quick-response-form/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/oss-quick-response-form/)) or email oss@ramapo.edu. Complete it and email it with supporting documentation to oss@ramapo.edu. Documentation must support the request and be submitted by a qualified professional. For medical conditions, OSS lists documentation guidelines and a writable Medical Impairments Documentation Form: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/documentation-requirements/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/documentation-requirements/) [8,9] Comprehensive documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist is required to establish eligibility and determine appropriate accommodations. [3]

If you request only a strobe alarm, roll-in shower, wheelchair/mobility accessible residence hall, or 1st floor, you do not need the Housing Accommodation Student or Provider Request Forms; complete only a request for disability support form. [3]

OSS reviews your request, usually with the Housing Accommodation Request Committee. Expect a decision within twenty one (21) business days after OSS receives all requested documentation. OSS may request more information or contact the professional who provided it. [4] Once approved, OSS informs Residence Life, which works with you on placement; arrangements depend on availability and are not guaranteed. [1,6,7] Requests should be submitted no later than Residence Life’s published deadlines; a late request may prevent Residence Life from meeting an approved accommodation for the requested semester. [1,2] See OSS’s housing-accommodation page and policy for details and forms: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/) [5]

For a kitchen placement request, first meet with Dining Services to determine whether your dietary needs can be met; if they cannot, affiliate with OSS and submit a formal request. [https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/](https://ramapo.sodexomyway.com/) [6]

The Public Policy MPP is a Master of Public Policy in the School of Social Sciences and Social Work. It studies how governmental laws and policies shape lives, and trains students in research methodologies, quantitative and qualitative methods, and skills for work with or for public institutions. [1]

Requirements: complete all seven required courses: PUBL 600 THE POLITICS OF POLICYMAKING; PUBL 601 FEDERAL PUBLIC POLICY & GOVERNANCE; PUBL 602 STATE & LOCAL PUBLIC POLICY; PUBL 616 ECONOMETRICS AND ANALYSIS; PUBL 618 PUBLIC MANAGEMENT; PUBL 621 POLITICAL ECONOMY; and PUBL 705 PUBLIC POLICY INTERNSHIP. Select 3 at least 3 electives from the catalog’s listed options. [1] Other published levels: Public Policy 4+1 and Public Policy Minor. [1]

Graduate Admissions lists one letter of recommendation (professional or academic). Enter references’ names and contact information in the “Recommendations” section of the online application; Ramapo sends an automated request, and references upload recommendations to the application portal. The letter is waived for current Ramapo students graduating in 2027 and recent Ramapo graduates from 2025 and 2026. Also required: a 400-word personal statement describing your interest, how the program fits your personal intellectual development, and what you expect to accomplish by enrolling; and a resume. [6]

**Graduate Admissions**: Phone: (201) 684-7270. Email: graduate@ramapo.edu. Location: McBride House. [15]

answer:
That's stressful, but one bad grade doesn't decide everything. Talking with your professor and an advisor soon can really help.

A grade appeal requires documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. Appeals based only on needing a higher grade, or on an Academic Integrity penalty, will not be considered. [2]

Undergraduate: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to your course instructor, with supporting documentation. You and the instructor have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you cannot agree, send a written appeal, including relevant course materials or work, to the Dean of the academic unit that sponsored the course within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. If the Dean does not support your appeal, you may petition the Office of the Provost in writing, by email or certified letter, within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination; explain your position and include evidence contradicting the Dean’s decision or information previously unavailable. The Provost’s Office may reject petitions without clear evidence of a factual mistake, policy violation, or action outside the Dean’s purview. [3]

Graduate: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to the faculty member, with supporting documentation. You and the faculty member have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If you cannot agree, send a written appeal, including relevant course materials or work, to the graduate program Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Director’s decision is a recommendation to the Dean for final approval. [4]

Office of the Provost handles the undergraduate petition described above.

The Office of Specialized Services (OSS) handles disability-related housing accommodation requests. First, register for affiliation with OSS and initiate contact; see “How To Request OSS Services” ([https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/how-to-request-oss-services/)). Submit comprehensive disability documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist. You must also complete an Affiliation Packet; request it through the OSS Quick Response Form ([https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/oss-quick-response-form/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/oss-quick-response-form/)) or email oss@ramapo.edu. Send the completed packet and supporting documentation electronically to oss@ramapo.edu. [3][9]

For the housing request forms and full instructions, see OSS’s Housing Accommodations page and its linked policy: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/housing-accommodations/) [3][5] If you request only a strobe alarm, roll-in shower, wheelchair/mobility accessible residence hall, or 1st floor, you do not need the Housing Accommodation Student or Provider Request Forms; complete only a request for disability support form. [3]

Requests are typically reviewed by a committee. OSS says to expect a decision within twenty one (21) business days after it receives all requested documentation; if more information is needed, OSS will inform you in writing. [4] Submit by Residence Life’s published deadlines. Accommodations depend on availability, are not guaranteed, and a late request may prevent an approved accommodation from being met for the requested semester. [1][2][7]

It studies how governmental laws and policies shape human lives and trains students in research methodologies, quantitative and qualitative methods, and skills for work with or for public institutions. [1]

Requirements: Required Courses all of: PUBL 600 THE POLITICS OF POLICYMAKING; PUBL 601 FEDERAL PUBLIC POLICY & GOVERNANCE; PUBL 602 STATE & LOCAL PUBLIC POLICY; PUBL 616 ECONOMETRICS AND ANALYSIS; PUBL 618 PUBLIC MANAGEMENT; PUBL 621 POLITICAL ECONOMY; PUBL 705 PUBLIC POLICY INTERNSHIP. Electives - Select 3 at least 3 of: ACCT 502 GOVERNMENT AND NOT-FOR-PROFIT ACCOUNTING; ACCT 625 INTERNATIONAL ACCOUNTING; BADM 501 DATA ANALYTICS; BADM 503 BUSINESS LAW, ETHICS & REGULATORY PRONOUNCEMENTS; DATA 601 INTRODUCTION TO DATA SCIENCE; DATA 670 DATA VISUALIZATION; MATH 570 APPLIED STATISTICS; MATH 685 INTRODUCTION TO EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN; MBAD 610 BECOMING A 21ST CENTURY LEADER; MBAD 625 CRISIS & CHANGE MANAGEMENT; NURS 660 LEADERSHIP AND INNOVATION IN HEALTHCARE; NURS 670 HEALTHCARE ECONOMICS AND FINANCE; NURS 808 HEALTH POLICY LEADERSHIP; MSWK 505 SOCIAL WELFARE PROGRAMS AND POLICIES I; MSWK 507 CULTURAL DIVERSITY, RACISM, OPPRESSION AND PRIVILEGE; MSWK 604 ADVANCED SOCIAL POLICY; MSWK 610 PUBLIC HEALTH IN WEST AFRICA; MSWK 670 SOCIAL WELFARE POLICIES IN HEALTH AND MENTAL HEALTH. The Nursing RN to BSN is a Bachelor of Science in Nursing track designed for registered nurses with an Associate’s degree or Diploma in nursing. Students transfer credits from their initial nursing program and complete Ramapo’s general education and nursing requirements. Ramapo’s Nursing programs are accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN). Complete all RN to BSN Professional Core courses: NURS 312 NURSING INFORMATICS; NURS 316 PATHOPHYSIOLOGY; NURS 325 NURSING RESEARCH AND EVIDENCE BASED PRACTICE; NURS 330 HEALTH ASSESSMENT ACROSS THE LIFESPAN; NURS 425 COMMUNITY CENTERED NURSING; NURS 445 LEADERSHIP IN A GLOBAL WORLD; and NURS 460 CLINICAL MANAGEMENT. Select 1 elective; students should consult their Nursing advisor for elective course options. [1]

That's stressful, but one bad grade doesn't decide everything. Talking with your professor and an advisor soon can really help.

Grade appeals are considered only in limited circumstances and require supporting documentation. Possible grounds include a computational error, factual information not considered when the grade was posted, or an alleged College Policy violation. Appeals based only on wanting a higher grade, or on a grade penalty for an Academic Integrity violation, will not be considered. After a degree is conferred, its academic record cannot be adjusted. [2]

The Office of the Provost publishes separate procedures for undergraduate and graduate students. [3][4]

Undergraduate: Within 20 calendar days after grades are posted, email or send a certified letter to the course instructor with supporting documentation. The instructor and student have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If unresolved, submit a written appeal by email or certified letter, with pertinent course materials or coursework, to the Dean of the academic unit that sponsored the course within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. The Dean has 15 calendar days to decide. If the Dean does not support the appeal, petition the Office of the Provost by written statement via email or certified letter within 20 calendar days of the Dean’s final written determination; include your position and evidence contradicting the decision or information previously unavailable. The Provost may reject petitions lacking clear evidence of factual mistake, policy violation, or action outside the Dean’s purview. [3]

Graduate: The first deadline is also 20 calendar days after grades are posted; write to the faculty member by email or certified letter and provide supporting documentation. The parties have up to 15 calendar days to reach a determination. If unresolved, submit a written appeal by email or certified letter, including pertinent course materials or coursework, to the sponsoring graduate program’s Director within 20 calendar days of the final determination conference. If the Director does not support the appeal, you may petition the Dean who supervises the program with a written statement and evidence; the page gives no deadline for that petition. [4]

The Office of Specialized Services (OSS) handles student housing accommodation requests. First, register for affiliation with OSS; students must initiate contact. See “How To Request OSS Services” for more information. Submit comprehensive disability documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist. [3]

All students must complete an Affiliation Packet. Request one through the OSS Quick Response Form or by emailing OSS; send the completed packet and supporting documentation electronically to OSS. [9] For medical impairment documentation, OSS also provides guidelines and a writable Medical Impairments Documentation Form. [8]

If you are requesting only a strobe alarm, roll-in shower, wheelchair/mobility accessible residence hall, or 1st floor, you do not need to complete the Housing Accommodation Student or Provider Request Forms; complete only a request for disability support form. [3]

After affiliation, OSS informs Residence Life of residents requiring specific housing accommodations based on documentation. Submit requests by Residence Life’s published deadlines. [1] Requests are reviewed by OSS and, in most cases, the Housing Accommodation Request Committee. A decision is expected within twenty one (21) business days after OSS receives all requested documentation; OSS may ask for more information. [4,6] Accommodations depend on availability, are not guaranteed, and late requests may not be met for the semester requested. [2,7]

See the OSS Housing Accommodations page for the policy and necessary forms. [5,7]

The Office of Specialized Services (OSS) handles requests. An emotional support animal may be allowed as a disability accommodation, but it requires approval; it may be limited to defined campus areas and generally is not permitted in academic or recreational facilities. [2][3]

1. First register with OSS and submit comprehensive disability documentation from a licensed physician, psychiatrist, psychologist, social worker, or certified learning disabilities specialist. [5]
2. Call OSS at 201-684-7514 to discuss your interest; interested students will be scheduled to meet with the OSS Director. [1]
3. Submit the Animal Documentation Form: [https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2022/07/Animal-Documentation-Form-fillable-updated-7-5-22.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/wp-content/uploads/sites/137/2022/07/Animal-Documentation-Form-fillable-updated-7-5-22.pdf) [7]
4. OSS staff review the request and, in most cases, the Housing Accommodation Request Committee reviews it; if approved, OSS works with Residence Life on placement. [6]

OSS and/or the committee may deny a request if it is unreasonable or insufficiently documented. Reasons include inadequate evidence, an undue financial or administrative burden, altering housing policy, or a direct threat or substantial property-damage risk. For an animal request, the College may also ask about the animal’s age, size, or breed. [4]

Housing accommodations are limited, first-come-first-served, and not guaranteed; deadlines matter. A late OSS request may prevent Residence Life from meeting an approved accommodation for the semester requested. [8][15]
